problem:
$$
A=[\begin{aligned}1 & -2 & 1 \\ -1 & 2 & -1 \\ 2 & -2 & 0\end{aligned}],\,b=[\begin{aligned}-2 \\ 0 \\ 1\end{aligned}].
$$

Consider the matrix $A$ and vector $b$ shown above. If the general least-squares solution of $Ax=b$ is given by

$$
[\begin{aligned}2 \\ b \\ c\end{aligned}]+{x}_{3}[\begin{aligned}a \\ 1 \\ 1\end{aligned}],\,{x}_{3}\in R
$$

what is the value of $a+2b+c?$
